newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FIVE SENT OFF IN CHESTERFIELD-PLYMOUTH MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIVE SENT OFF IN CHESTERFIELD-PLYMOUTH MATCH.

text.p: Five players were sent off in Saturday's English second division match between Chesterfield, F.A. Cup conquerors of Nottingham Forest last weekend, and Plymouth.
Plymouth's Ronnie Mauge was dismissed in the 36th minute for violent conduct.
Chesterfield's Darren Carr and Kevin Davies and Plymouth's Tony James and Richard Logan were sent off after a brawl in the final minute.
